Description: Family storytime with songs, games and reading.

Join us as CMOM transforms into a sprawling winter city entirely created by you! Add to our collaborative installation, by designing glowing decorations, mini architectural sculptures, tiny transportation systems, and joyful holiday scenes that reflect this special time of the year!

Inspired by storytelling traditions and textile arts, create layered collage “story blankets” using fabric, stamps, paper, and symbolic imagery to tell stories about home, nature, family, and community.

Activity Name: Author Event: The Ones Who Came Before with Kevin Maillard and Illustrator Sibu T.P.
Description: Join author Kevin Maillard, the award-winning author of Fry Bread , to celebrate the release of his book, The Ones Who Came Before ! This picture book follows a Native American “city kid” named Aabanya who encounters a bear while visiting her grandfather. Interwoven with indigenous concepts about land and the natural world, Kevin Maillard’s thought-provoking story and artist Sibu T. P.’s rich, vibrant illustrations come together in this contemplation of heritage, ancestry, sharing sp

Description: Join Mvskoke cultural worker and educator Liana Shewey for stories and activities in honor of Indigenous Heritage Month. Our interactive storytime will invite you to celebrate the changing of the seasons with a read-aloud of Autumn: A Picture Book by Mvskoke author Alexander Posey and illustrations by Salish artist Paige Pettibon, and then you’ll collaborate on a creating a nature poem. It’s the season to be grateful for our friends and family ! Create a fall critter friend out of pinecones, twigs, leaves, and other fun natural materials and gift it to someone you care about.
What colors do you see during autumn? Apply warm colors of paint to paper using painting tools to create an autumn scene!

Activity Name: Workshop with the New Victory Theater: Tilt! An 80’s Circus Thrill Ride
Description: Join us for a special workshop and activities inspired by the performance Tilt! An ’80s Circus Thrill Ride .

Activity Name: Workshop: Cooking Lesson with Harlem Grown
Description: Children and families will join Harlem Grown Chef educator Sasha Dubose for a hands- on cooking lesson, at the Children’s Museum of Manhattan. Participants will practice basic cooking skills, explore recipe creation, and discover the cultural history and traditions behind food. The recipe we will be making will be delicious Pumpkin Queso Nachos!

Activity Name: Author Storytime with Special Guests: Between the Balloons with Artist E.A. KAHANE and Tom Toro for Aperture Kids
Description: Larger-than-life balloon characters, marching bands, and delightful surprises fill every page of this magical take on the famed Thanksgiving Day Parade. A playful blend of photography and illustration, Between the Balloons reveals that with imagination anything you see can become something extraordinary. Activity Name: Workshop with the Whitney Museum Pop-Up Open Studio: Roy Lichtenstein
Description: You are invited to join us for a special pop-up Whitney Open Studio at CMOM, celebrating the pop artist Roy Lichtenstein and the Whitney’s retrospective Roy Lichtenstein: Like New . Whitney Family Programs brings artmaking to CMOM as we create large scale, collaborative pieces. Join us for hands on artmaking, a pop art library, and an opportunity to learn about Lichtenstein, who grew up on the Upper West Side.

Learn about and make your own healthy meal with Casa Lu, in both Spanish and in English! Explore global recipes and create a reflective family art project to take home. Make seasonal recipes made with organic ingredients, and practice essential cooking skills. We’ll be making the filling for and putting together pumpkin whoopie pies and special Argentinian alfajores.

Activity Name: Author Read Aloud: Plátanos Are Love with Author Alyssa Reynoso-Morris
Description: Join author Alyssa Reynoso-Morris for a delicious picture book and art activity afterwards! The book focuses on the ways plantains shape Latinx culture, community, and family, told through a young girl’s experiences in the kitchen with her abuela. With every pop of the tostones, mash of the mangú, and sizzle of the maduros, a little girl learns that plátanos are her history, they are her culture, and—most importantly—they are love. Activity Name: The People We Are Thankful For
Description: Draw details on small paper people cutouts. Use a pipe cleaner to string the people together and make a banner that represents the people you are thankful for.

That’s how much kids love Brooklyn’s AnnaPadgett. Your little one will fall under the singer’s folksy/funky spell.” ( The New York Post ) If We Must We Must is an infectious collection of uninhibited songs that effortlessly traverse the diverse terrain of childhood. Activity Name: Music and Marks Performance and Artmaking: Juilliard Performers
Description: Join Hire Juilliard Performers for an exciting performance with soulful jazz vocalist Julia Smulson and guitar accompaniment by Aaron Matson! Make your own marks and artworks along with the changing tempos of the music and reflect on all you’re grateful for!

Activity Name: Performance: DIVI ROXX KIDS: A Celebration of Self-Love, Positivity & Hip-Hop
Description: Get ready to dance with 2X Grammy-nominated bassist and songwriter Divinity Roxx whose Divi Roxx Kids experience is an electrifying, family hip-hop concert that blends world-class musicianship with an empowering celebration of confidence and community. Known globally for her work with Beyoncé and Victor Wooten, Divinity blends heavy bass grooves, funk, and lyrical storytelling to create an immersive live experience parents and children will appreciate equally. Activity Name: Music and Marks Performance and Artmaking: Happy Hanukkah with Meshuganah Mambo!
Description: Come for a celebratory Hanukkah experience at CMOM with special artmaking and an exciting performance! Meshuganah Mambo plays music that is uniquely New York: a fusion of klezmer melodies with mambo and Cumbia rhythms for a one-of-a-kind sound. Hop along to playful, groove-forward music that’s immediately engaging and deeply soulful and leave with special cards to give to your loved ones this holiday season. 2026-27 Jewish holiday programs are supported by UJA Federation New York.
Inspired by winter greenery and traditions of decorating, create a magical ornament filled with pinecones, bark textures, ribbons, and reflective materials.

Activity Name: The Mitten by Jan Brett inspired Sensory Bin
Description: Explore a small winter forest with your hands! Find the different animals in the snow while you learn about camouflage and how these animals stay warm in the winter. Keep an eye out for a special white “mitten” in this Jan Brett inspired sensory bin.
